items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: So they allowed me, Jerry Coker, they had a jazz department

ctx.x: Yes. Let’s see, I’m going to try and make a synopsis of the whole time. When I entered the University of Miami, having the background that we just talked about — I had a cousin who is an incredible blues guitarist and all this beautiful music happening in my life, I had an aunt who was best friends with the guy that owned the record store so she had everything, you know every new release from everybody and we’d have to go over to her house to hear that stuff because we couldn’t listen to it at our own house. So I…

year of school. And I’m in this classical department and I’m doing all of the arias and I’m learning all this stuff and it was great because I got wonderful vocal instruction that has allowed me to sustain a fifty year career so thank you for that. But David was also at the University of Miami in the jazz department. We did not know that we were both ending up in the same university. We had no idea that this was happening to us. So when I got there, and maybe it was because I had sort of become familiar with some…
Did the classical music voice teachers ever say to you, “I don’t like what I’m hearing, where is this coming from? Are you doing jazz? Or were you blessed with open-minded profs?
